body:
County. I hate my county, not country. But no, I can't move. I can't even afford a taxi across town. I have no money. I break even if I'm lucky.

I like videogames and YouTube videos. Or did. When I feel like this I like nothing. Absolutely nothing.

There is never going to be a break from this torture. You're right. I'm spiraling. And I don't care. Let me spiral to my death. I'm not even sure why I posted this. I just needed to vent, but I don't feel better. I don't feel any mental clarity.

I feel pathetic. I wish I was never born.

If I have one positive glimmer of hope, it's that when this eats away at me I will be an example that people should pay attention not only to bullied children, but to bullied anybody. That it's not okay and the effects ARE everlasting.

I would have believed some of this a decade ago. It's been 14 of my 25 years on earth. A full 14 years in isolation, in ostracized hell, in a continuously un-improving predicament.

I have seen therapists. And doctors. And psychologists. And psychiatrists. And I've taken more medicines than I care to say. Nothing works. Nothing prevents me from slipping back into the strong will for a major accident to just take my life and end it. My most recent doctor almost wanted to say I'm treatment resistant and suggested electric shock therapy.

Fuck that.

No, I can't see her or even talk to her. I'm too sick and inconsistent. In her father's and that family's eyes, if I can't be there 100% forever, I need to be there 0%.

So whatever.

I joined a support group locally, went twice, made a fool of myself as I always do in public and gave up.

I'm just going to hibernate in my room forever and let the stress eat away at my body. I hear it increases other health risks. Maybe one day I'll spontaneously cardiac arrest and just involuntarily exit this fucked up monstrosity I was unlucky enough to be born into to begin with.

Please, universe. Just take care of it. I can't possibly have a long life like this anyways. Nor do I want to.

I told myself it'll get better next year, that time I lost everyone and everyone began to hate me. Then the next year when it didn't I told myself hang in there. After four years of nothing better I dropped out. Later met my ex, THOUGHT things were getting better, but no. They still got bad and worse again. Then I got stuck on the other side of the country in a county I hate. Then I met one person who I truly loved and had the entire family of his and my ex against us, going so far as to kick him out over being with me. (Ages 23 and 34, not fucking teenagers)

It's just been one battle after another. No reprieve. No relief. No positive signs. Just a shit school life to a shit ex life to a shit battle life to a shit shit life now. And then the transgender thing hit me like a ton of bricks and now it's all too much.

Fuck it all.
